**[named bool] bare true/false as a template argument**

Same as line 3724: the bare false binds to the template parameter Permuted of make_llm_executor [h/tron/models/common.hpp:77]. It shares the PERMUTED_FALSE definition proposed there, or uses the alias tron::host.

Proposed:
```cpp
      model<llm<llm_config, make_llm_executor<PERMUTED_FALSE, tensor, tensor, tensor>>>;
```
